body:
Strata's SYCL queues, host uploads and recorded MTP graphs could outlive their backing storage. This draft repairs those lifetimes, preserves reproducible diagnostics for remaining long-prefill and restoration failures, and integrates upstream Niko1221/Strata through 82f46a8c8f475f001ad76d92f58f4a4f8ffb0253. Experimental weight release and expert queue pacing remain off by default.

Changes:

- Own and drain queues before storage destruction; reject foreign queues and unsafe selectors. Complete staging/MTP host uploads before reuse, propagate asynchronous errors, and validate USM/VMM properties.
- Retire recorded MTP/verifier graph arrays before releasing their backing, rebuild after immutable RAM weights are restored, and publish readiness only after successful restoration.
- Replace unsatisfied legacy device waits with host completion boundaries, synchronize doorbell publication, defer BLAS/codebook initialization, and use aligned IQ4 byte-word reads and defined FP16/INT8 K/V vector conversions.
- Remove the unused 32 MiB migrated cuBLAS workspace. Add free-memory, layer/chunk and completed CLI-window traces, plus bounded owned GDB/PTY supervision with process identity checks, main-thread snapshots and normal successful Linux shutdown.
- Capture flushed Level Zero entry/results, parameter validation and UR tracing for first correctness checks. Keep these settings separate from clean timing.
- Add optional `STRATA_PREFILL_EXPERT_WAIT_BATCH=0..256`; default zero preserves the existing schedule and arithmetic.
- Preserve the one-command recovery helper's refusal of unresolved clients, GUI shutdown and unsafe resets; document recovery and firmware audit limits. Recovery operations are separate from tuning.
- Reconcile upstream's rewritten history using the exact whole-tree match between old 6f32ec07 and new a1641e9f, followed by a normal merge. Resolve five conflicts while retaining local lifetime, graph and host-atomic fixes. Update shared API signatures, optional host-registration waits, CPU file-source methods and GCC object symbol names. Explicitly reject unsupported CUDA fused/padded modes; upstream CUDA elastic K/V stays unavailable while the existing Level Zero expert-cache mapping remains.

Validation uses Arc B570 10 GiB, Ryzen 5 5600X, 128 GiB RAM, kernel 7.0.0-38-generic, NEO 26.31.39395.14, Level Zero 1.32.0, IGC 2.41.5 and oneAPI 2026.1.1. [Evidence index](bench/results/2026-10-05-sycl-prefill-scaling/gpu-stall-diagnosis/README.md) links exact manifests, source/controller hashes, terminal records and bounded diagnostic logs.

- CPU production-source controls expose queue/registry, upload and reclamation failures and pass after ordering fixes. Installed-tag NEO/ASan stand-ins reproduce residency surviving physical release; they do not identify the object in the actual runtime crash.
- Ten post-reboot model processes complete 40 short requests. With direct submission and copy offload disabled, retained/released controls match IDs, printed logprobs and all 248,320 first-head floats, including 66 persistent state payloads when captured. Default copy offload also diverges in retained controls, so a general runtime cause is unresolved.
- The frozen b81 executable completes a CLI request consuming all 262,144 cells, through KV cell 262143, with two finite outputs and normal exit. Full normal-MTP serving attempts with baseline, waits every 32 experts, waits every expert and the legacy adapter still stop in completion paths. Owned cleanup and subsequent logged exact-word GPU probes pass without reset. Queue pacing and adapter selection alone are insufficient; CSR tag differences are not live kernel job counts.
- [Profiler evidence](bench/results/2026-10-05-sycl-prefill-scaling/gpu-stall-diagnosis/profiling-20261007/README.md): unitrace/control short and 2K runs match whole heads/IDs/logprobs. The 2K trace measures explicit H2D at 6.163 GB/s and 4.62848 s in 100,060 expert dequant launches, about 60% of kernel duration. Profiling adds about 30% to that phase-logged control's prompt time; inclusive host/device durations must not be added or reported as clean throughput.
- The private dequant property change passes 144 guarded FP16 output pairs (354,511,872 bytes per side); original 144 cooperative launches become zero. The [actual-wrapper receipt](bench/results/2026-10-05-sycl-prefill-scaling/gpu-stall-diagnosis/dequant-actual-wrappers-20261007/README.md) covers isolated wrappers, not integrated model parity, speed or full capacity. Production kernel properties remain unchanged.
- The private lazy verifier completes one 262,140-input/four-output request but aborts during main-cache restoration on the next request. The [unchanged eager full-context comparison](bench/results/2026-10-05-sycl-prefill-scaling/gpu-stall-diagnosis/verifier-eager-full-20261007/README.md) also fills all cells: IDs match lazy, but all first-head floats and logprob lines differ (maximum absolute head difference 0.412168). Strict comparison stops before the next request; cleanup and logged GPU health pass without new xe faults. Neither variant is adopted as a capacity fix.
- The [optional expanded-FP16 cache preparation](bench/results/2026-10-05-sycl-prefill-scaling/gpu-stall-diagnosis/expanded-fp16-cache-prepared-20261007/README.md) preserves FP16 formulas and bounds admission by free VRAM minus256 MiB. Its subsequent model checks and acceptance failures are recorded below; the candidate remains unadopted. The [pinned B70 reference audit](bench/results/2026-10-05-sycl-prefill-scaling/gpu-stall-diagnosis/b70-offload-reference-20261007/README.md) records applicable event-ordering ideas and hardware differences; no foreign code was run.
- [Upstream integration checks](bench/results/2026-10-05-sycl-prefill-scaling/gpu-stall-diagnosis/upstream-refresh-20261007/README.md): isolated SYCL Release build passes; 452 serve tests pass with eight skips; all 24 setup scripts and four existing standalone CPU tests pass. Updated binary ceff2d8a…680c0bd0 matches pre-update IDs, every logprob and every first-head byte for four context-128 normal-MTP requests and a context-4096/int8-KV/2048-input request with prefill cap1024. Seven total MTP release/restore pairs complete. Both jobs exit normally with no surviving owners or new xe faults. No reset, service change or system package change was used.

- The [integrated dequant model check](bench/results/2026-10-05-sycl-prefill-scaling/gpu-stall-diagnosis/dequant-model-refresh-20261007/README.md) rebuilds the private property-only candidate against the refreshed upstream control. Four fully logged normal-MTP requests match all output values and complete six release/restore pairs. The following API-log-disabled 2048-input pair with prefill cap1024 also matches all head bytes, IDs and logprobs: prompt 35.8242 s control versus 35.6255 s candidate (0.555% less time). Both exit normally without new xe faults. One sample per side does not distinguish this small difference from noise; the candidate remains unadopted and its full256K gates are incomplete.

- [Expanded-FP16 model checks and resource query](bench/results/2026-10-05-sycl-prefill-scaling/gpu-stall-diagnosis/expanded-fp16-cache-model-20261007/README.md): cache-zero four-request short parity passes, but active cache128, the regular-dequant cache128 candidate, and the exact same candidate with cache disabled all stop during2K dequant completion wait. A fully logged recheck of unchanged updated control ceff also stops. No failed run completes output; all owners are removed and four subsequent logged exact-word GPU probes pass without invoking reset. The first failure logs a CCS engine reset near watchdog cleanup; the other three have no new xe fault. Both actual IQ kernels report1152 cooperative groups at local size32, below original GU/down counts12800/6400. Removing the unnecessary cooperative setting alone is insufficient. No cache speed claim or0/128/256 timing matrix is accepted. Production kernel properties remain unchanged.

- [Completion stress and wider cooperative audit](bench/results/2026-10-05-sycl-prefill-scaling/gpu-stall-diagnosis/completion-stress-and-cooperative-audit-20261007/README.md): four owned processes each complete 20,000 real-weight GU/down pairs and 40 full guarded-output comparisons; the extended cases also use unchanged GEMM/SwiGLU consumers. One case per fixture retires a consumed 64 MiB VMM mapping before stress. All exit normally without new xe faults and initial outputs match across modes. These bounded component checks exclude complete requests, routing/staging and recorded decode graphs; their diagnostic durations are not clean throughput. A separate query submits no kernels and finds 22 of 25 observed original prefill/IQ cooperative combinations above measured limits. GDN output normalization uses 49,152 groups versus a maximum 288; broadcast uses 40,960 versus 144. All 45 observed cooperative combinations map uniquely to eight source files. The query assumes zero extra dynamic local bytes; source mapping is not a complete synchronization proof. Per-function review must preserve actual persistent/global coordination. No production property correction is adopted yet.

- [Integrated ordinary-launch candidate and zero-flag stall](bench/results/2026-10-05-sycl-prefill-scaling/gpu-stall-diagnosis/observed-regular-launch-model-20261007/README.md): a private property-only build removes 44 reviewed declarations across eight files, preserving arithmetic, names, ranges, waits and every other archive member. Four context-128 requests match all frozen head bytes, IDs and logprobs, complete six release/restore pairs and exit normally. The first 2K repeat stops at layer40/token256 during completion wait, then the 60-second watchdog aborts. Its 258,136 successful native/UR enqueue associations contain zero cooperative flags; submission success does not prove device completion or audit every recorded command-buffer operation. Flag removal is therefore insufficient to prevent the wait. Both owners are removed, no new xe fault appears and fresh logged exact-word GPU health passes without reset. A no-launch query separately finds four of seven remaining short-path cooperative combinations above measured bounds. Those other paths still need correction. A same-binary control retaining main/MTP backing and graphs is prepared but unexecuted. No candidate is adopted or clean-speed claim accepted.

- Correction to earlier two-chunk labels: these2048-input tests actually prefill256/1024/767 tokens plus one input token in decode. The successful updated-control trace contains144 entries (48 layers times three chunks). Configured conditions and timing values are unchanged; prior frozen archives retain their original manifests.

The complete repeated 262144-cell CLI/normal-MTP serve, clipped-tail, overflow-refusal and later-valid gates remain incomplete. The full-context eager/lazy head difference, repeat-prefill allocation failure and timing-dependent parity failures are unresolved. PP1000/TG70 is not achieved. Short correctness receipts and logged health probes do not establish general hang prevention or clean throughput. This PR remains a draft; no main-branch merge is requested.
